meta.title: About
meta.description: A four-star, Irish-owned hotel in the heart of Old Town Sarajevo, blending traditional Irish hospitality with Bosnian charm.

image.alt: Hotel Central's façade and corner tower on Ćumurija street

title: Irish hospitality
Bosnian charm
blocks.intro: Experience the charm of Old Town Sarajevo at our four-star, Irish-owned hotel.

blocks.label: (01) The hotel
title: Old Town
Sarajevo
body: Nestled in the heart of Old Town Sarajevo, Hotel Central blends traditional Irish hospitality with Bosnian charm to offer you a truly unique stay. Located just steps away from historic landmarks such as the Old Bazaar and Baščaršija Square, Hotel Central provides the perfect base for exploring the rich culture and history of Sarajevo.
Whether you're visiting Sarajevo for business or pleasure, Hotel Central offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and hospitality.

images.alt: The hotel's façade lit at night
Terrace of the presidential suite above the rooftops

blocks.label: (02) Rooms
title: Completely
refurbished
body: Each of our completely refurbished, well-appointed rooms is designed with your comfort in mind, featuring modern amenities and stylish decor.
Start your day with a delicious breakfast buffet and Bosnian coffee at our on-site restaurant.

images.alt: A suite with patterned wallpaper and seating area

blocks.text: A perfect blend of comfort, convenience and hospitality.

blocks.label: (03) Unwind
title: After a day
of sightseeing
body: Unwind and relax in our sauna, steam room and 25 m pool as well as our state of the art fitness center spread over three floors.
Our friendly and attentive staff are always on hand to ensure you have a memorable stay.

images.alt: Living room of the presidential suite
Treatment room of the day spa

title: Rooms

meta.title: Club & Spa
meta.description: A heated 25-metre pool, Finnish sauna, steam bath, caldarium, plunge pool, a gym over three floors and the Wellness Day Spa at Hotel Central Sarajevo.

image.alt: The heated 25-metre indoor pool with a wave mosaic

title: Relaxation
& wellness
blocks.intro: A relaxation and wellness oasis in Sarajevo.

blocks.label: (01) Pool
title: A tranquil
poolside escape
body: Immerse yourself in serenity at our 25-meter pool. Whether you're looking to swim laps or simply relax by the water, our pool provides a peaceful sanctuary for guests of all ages.
Relax in our Finnish sauna, unwind in our steam bath, rejuvenate in our caldarium — a low-temperature sauna at 40–50 °C with heated benches — and cool off in the plunge pool.

images.alt: Curved pool edge with tiled benches

items.v: Cardio and strength over three floors

blocks.label: (02) Fitness
title: Three floors
of fitness
body: Maintain your fitness regime at our state-of-the-art gym, featuring three floors of cardio and strength training equipment. Whether you're a fitness enthusiast or just starting out, our gym offers everything you need to stay active during your stay.
Group classes include yoga, pilates, HIIT, kettlebell, aqua aerobic, indoor spinning and more.

images.alt: The pool hall of the Club & Spa

blocks.label: (03) Wellness Day Spa
title: Treatments
& rituals
body: Treat yourself to a host of treatments at any of our six deluxe therapy rooms — including massage, facials, pedicures and manicures.
Two hours of free pool area access with all treatments booked.

images.alt: Relaxation lounge with a forest mural
Treatment room of the day spa
The pool and its mosaic wall

image.alt: The breakfast buffet at Restaurant Central

title: Restaurant
Central
blocks.intro: A tranquil escape where every morning begins with a delightful breakfast.

blocks.label: (01) Breakfast
title: Every morning
a ritual
body: Nestled in the heart of Sarajevo, Hotel Central is a tranquil escape where every morning begins with a delightful breakfast experience. Start your day with a sumptuous breakfast spread at our charming restaurant, featuring a tempting selection of local delicacies and international favorites.
And, of course, Bosnian coffee.

images.alt: Breakfast tray with tea and croissants
Bosnian coffee in a copper džezva

blocks.label: (02) Corporate dining
title: Catered
lunches
body: In addition to our breakfast offerings, we also provide catered lunches for corporate events upon request.
Whether you're hosting a business meeting, conference, or seminar, our culinary team will craft a bespoke menu to suit your event's needs.

images.alt: Cheese and cold cuts at the buffet

meta.title: Meetings & Events
meta.description: A fully equipped conference room on the third floor of Hotel Central Sarajevo for seminars, conferences, workshops, presentations, weddings and business lunches.

image.alt: The conference room on the third floor

title: The space
to connect
blocks.intro: Seminars, conferences, workshops, presentations, weddings and business lunches in the heart of old town Sarajevo.

blocks.label: (01) Conference room
title: Peace
& privacy
body: The conference room is located on the third floor, in a new and separate part of our premises, which guarantees peace and privacy. It is fully equipped with all necessary IT equipment and meets the needs for organizing all types of meetings, events and celebrations.
Modern and nicely decorated with all accompanying amenities, the conference room can change its setup and seating arrangement depending on the number of participants and the type of event.

images.alt: Theatre-style seating in the conference room
Reception counter in the conference area

blocks.label: (02) Your event
title: Entrust us
with it
body: Entrust us to handle the organization of your business event and your wishes will be realized, your business partners impressed.
All conference, meeting and event fees are negotiable and defined by individual request — hotel rooms, food and drinks, coffee breaks.

meta.title: Location
meta.description: Hotel Central is at Ćumurija 8 in the centre of Sarajevo, near the Sacred Heart Cathedral, the Latin Bridge and Baščaršija.

title: In the heart
of Sarajevo
blocks.intro: Sarajevo suits the walker. We're in the city centre and almost all sights are within walking distance.

transport.title: Taxi
transport.body: A taxi from the airport costs approximately 15 € / 30 KM and can be booked through our reception desk.

transport.title: Airport coach
transport.body: From Sarajevo Airport, ask for the Hotel Central stop at the Latin Bridge or at the Sacred Heart Cathedral. The ticket is normally 2.50 € / 5.00 KM single and 4 € / 8.00 KM return. The hotel is approximately 25 minutes from the airport. Timetables are on centrotrans.com.

transport.title: Bus & tram
transport.body: Bus stops beside the hotel serve the centre and surroundings, usually every 5–6 minutes. Tram no. 3 runs between Ilidža and Baščaršija (Old Town). Tickets are around 0.90 € / 1.80 KM.

transport.title: Sightseeing bus
transport.body: The Centrotrans sightseeing bus stops 50 m outside the hotel. Tours run daily from May to September, starting at 12:00 and 14:00.

transport.title: By car
transport.body: Enter “Hotel Central, Ćumurija, Sarajevo” as your destination. Leave the car in our secure, gated car park and explore on foot.

blocks.label: (02) On foot
title: Leave the car
and walk
body: Sarajevo suits the walkers. Why not leave the car in our secure, gated car park and just walk. We're in the city center and almost all sights are situated in walking distance.
It's the best way to stumble upon something interesting along the way.

images.alt: Hotel Central's corner on Ćumurija street at night
View over Sarajevo's rooftops from the terrace

meta.title: O nama
meta.description: Hotel sa četiri zvjezdice u vlasništvu irske kompanije, u srcu Starog grada Sarajeva — irsko gostoprimstvo i bosanski šarm.

image.alt: Hotel Central's façade and corner tower on Ćumurija street

title: Irsko gostoprimstvo
bosanski šarm
blocks.intro: Doživite potpuni šarm Starog grada Sarajeva u našem hotelu sa četiri zvjezdice, koji je u vlasništvu irske kompanije.

blocks.label: (01) Hotel
title: Stari grad
Sarajevo
body: Smješten u srcu Starog grada Sarajeva, Hotel Central spaja tradicionalno irsko gostoprimstvo sa bosanskim šarmom, nudeći vam zaista jedinstven boravak. Nalazi se na samo nekoliko koraka od historijskih znamenitosti kao što su Stari dio grada, Baščaršijski trg i sarajevska Katedrala, čineći ga savršenom polaznom tačkom za istraživanje bogate kulture i historije Sarajeva.
Bilo da posjećujete Sarajevo zbog posla ili zadovoljstva, Hotel Central nudi savršen spoj udobnosti i gostoprimstva.

images.alt: The hotel's façade lit at night
Terrace of the presidential suite above the rooftops

blocks.label: (02) Sobe
title: Potpuno
renovirane
body: Svaka od naših renoviranih, dobro opremljenih soba uređena je modernim sadržajima i elegantnim enterijerom, pružajući maksimalnu udobnost.
Započnite dan ukusnim doručkom na bazi švedskog stola i bosanskom kafom u našem hotelskom restoranu.

images.alt: A suite with patterned wallpaper and seating area

blocks.label: (03) Opuštanje
title: Nakon dana
razgledanja
body: Opustite se u našoj finskoj sauni, parnoj kupelji i bazenu od 25 metara, kao i u vrhunskom fitnes centru koji se prostire na tri etaže.
Ljubazno i pažljivo osoblje našeg hotela uvijek je pri ruci kako bi vam osiguralo nezaboravan boravak.

images.alt: Living room of the presidential suite
Treatment room of the day spa

blocks.intro: Šest kategorija, svaka potpuno renovirana i uređena za maksimalnu udobnost.

meta.title: Club & Spa
meta.description: Grijani bazen od 25 metara, finska sauna, parna kupelj, caldarium, bazen za hlađenje, teretana na tri sprata i Wellness Day Spa u Hotelu Central Sarajevo.

image.alt: The heated 25-metre indoor pool with a wave mosaic

title: Opuštanje
i wellness
blocks.intro: Oaza za opuštanje i wellness u Sarajevu.

blocks.label: (01) Bazen
title: Mirni bijeg
uz bazen
body: Uronite u spokoj na našem bazenu od 25 metara. Bilo da želite plivati krugove ili se jednostavno opustiti uz vodu, naš bazen pruža mirno utočište za goste svih uzrasta.
Opustite se u finskoj sauni i parnoj kupelji, obnovite se u caldariumu — sauni niske temperature od 40–50 °C sa grijanim klupama — i rashladite se u bazenu za hlađenje.

images.alt: Curved pool edge with tiled benches

items.v: Kardio i snaga na tri sprata

blocks.label: (02) Fitness
title: Tri sprata
fitnessa
body: Održavajte svoju fitness rutinu u našoj vrhunskoj teretani koja se prostire na tri sprata i sadrži kardio i opremu za jačanje mišića. Bilo da ste zaljubljenik u fitness ili tek počinjete, naša teretana nudi sve što vam je potrebno tokom vašeg boravka.
Grupni treninzi uključuju jogu, pilates, HIIT, kettlebell, aqua aerobik, indoor spinning i još mnogo toga.

images.alt: The pool hall of the Club & Spa

blocks.label: (03) Wellness Day Spa
title: Tretmani
i rituali
body: Priuštite sebi niz tretmana u nekoj od naših šest luksuznih tretman soba — uključujući masaže, tretmane lica, pedikir i manikir.
Dva sata besplatnog korištenja bazena uz sve rezervisane tretmane.

images.alt: Relaxation lounge with a forest mural
Treatment room of the day spa
The pool and its mosaic wall

title: Restoran
Central
blocks.intro: Mirna oaza u kojoj svako jutro počinje divnim iskustvom svježe pripremljenog doručka.

blocks.label: (01) Doručak
title: Svako jutro
ritual
body: Smješten u srcu Sarajeva, Hotel Central je mirna oaza u kojoj svako jutro počinje divnim iskustvom svježe pripremljenog doručka. Započnite dan u našem šarmantnom restoranu, gdje vas očekuje primamljiv izbor domaćih delicija i internacionalnih jela.
I, naravno, bosanska kafa.

images.alt: Breakfast tray with tea and croissants
Bosnian coffee in a copper džezva

blocks.label: (02) Poslovni ručkovi
title: Ručak
po mjeri
body: Osim izuzetne ponude doručka, na upit nudimo i ručak za poslovne događaje.
Bilo da organizujete poslovni sastanak, konferenciju ili seminar, naš kulinarski tim će osmisliti jelovnik po mjeri vašeg događaja.

images.alt: Cheese and cold cuts at the buffet

meta.title: Sastanci i događaji
meta.description: Potpuno opremljena konferencijska sala na trećem spratu Hotela Central Sarajevo za seminare, konferencije, radionice, prezentacije, vjenčanja i poslovne ručkove.

image.alt: The conference room on the third floor

title: Prostor
za susrete
blocks.intro: Seminari, konferencije, radionice, prezentacije, vjenčanja i poslovni ručkovi u samom centru Sarajeva.

blocks.label: (01) Konferencijska sala
title: Mir
i privatnost
body: Konferencijska sala smještena je na trećem spratu, u dijelu odvojenom od smještajnih jedinica, što garantira mir i privatnost. U potpunosti je opremljena svom potrebnom informatičkom opremom te udovoljava potrebama za organizacijom svih vrsta skupova.
Moderno i lijepo uređena sala sa svim pratećim sadržajima ima mogućnost promjene postava ovisno o broju sudionika i vrsti samog događaja.

images.alt: Theatre-style seating in the conference room
Reception counter in the conference area

blocks.label: (02) Vaš događaj
title: Povjerite
nam ga
body: Povjerite nam organizaciju Vašeg poslovnog događaja i Vaše će želje biti ostvarene, a Vaši poslovni partneri impresionirani.
Sve ponude i naknade formiraju se prema individualnim upitima — hotelski smještaj, sala za sastanke, hrana i piće, kafe pauze.

meta.title: Lokacija
meta.description: Hotel Central se nalazi na adresi Ćumurija 8, u centru Sarajeva, u blizini Katedrale, Latinske ćuprije i Baščaršije.

title: U srcu
Sarajeva
blocks.intro: Sarajevo je pogodno za šetanje. Nalazimo se u srcu grada i skoro sve znamenitosti su u blizini.

transport.title: Taxi
transport.body: Taxi od aerodroma košta otprilike 18 € / 35 KM, a od hotela do aerodroma 15 € / 30 KM. Taxi se može rezervisati preko recepcije hotela.

transport.title: Autobus sa aerodroma
transport.body: Na izlazu sa aerodroma nalazi se autobus Centrotrans; zamolite vozača za stanicu kod Latinske ćuprije ili Katedrale Srca Isusova. Karta košta 2,50 € / 5,00 KM u jednom pravcu i 4,00 € / 8,00 KM povratna. Hotel je udaljen otprilike 25 minuta od aerodroma. Red vožnje: centrotrans.com.

transport.title: Autobus i tramvaj
transport.body: Stanice gradskog prijevoza nalaze se u blizini hotela; autobusi obično voze svakih 5–6 minuta. Tramvaj broj 3 saobraća od Ilidže do Baščaršije. Karta košta oko 0,90 € / 1,80 KM.

transport.title: Turistički bus
transport.body: Stanica turističkog autobusa Centrotrans nalazi se 50 m od hotela. Ture se realizuju svaki dan od maja do septembra, sa početkom u 12:00 i 14:00.

transport.title: Autom
transport.body: Kao destinaciju unesite „Hotel Central, Ćumurija 8, Sarajevo“. Ostavite auto na našem sigurnom, ograđenom parkingu i istražite grad pješice.

blocks.label: (02) Pješice
title: Ostavite auto
i prošetajte
body: Sarajevo je pogodno za šetanje, a može biti frustrirajuće za vozače. Zašto ne biste ostavili auto na parkingu i jednostavno šetali? Nalazimo se u srcu grada i skoro sve znamenitosti su u blizini.
To je i najbolji način da „naletite“ na nešto interesantno.

View over Sarajevo's rooftops from the terrace
